visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of a light brown rabbit's face as it eats dark food pellets directly from an outstretched human hand. The rabbit's whiskers twitch, and its nose moves rhythmically. The background is a soft-focus dirt ground. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of two rabbits, one white and one tan, hopping across a sun-drenched grassy park area with wooden benches and trees. (3) A group of mixed-colored rabbits is seen resting together in the dirt shade beneath a large, leafy tree. (4) A medium shot captures a brown rabbit nestled in dry brush, using its hind paw to scratch its neck and ear. (5) On a bright green lawn, a white rabbit and a brown rabbit hop toward the camera. (6) A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt and black pants, is shown crouching on a path. She is surrounded by multiple brown rabbits leaping and clamoring for food in her hands. (7) Close-up shots follow, showing hands offering food to rabbits on the grass. (8) A first-person perspective shows a hand holding a red and white ferry ticket to Rabbit Island, with a large ferry ship visible in the blurred background harbor. (9) The camera shows the modern wooden exterior of the 'Rabbit Island Ferry Tickets' building. (10) Inside, a man in a patterned shirt interacts with a large automated ticket vending machine. (11) Rows of brown paper bags containing rabbit feed are displayed in wooden crates. (12) The woman browses a souvenir shop filled with rabbit-themed goods and packaged snacks on wooden shelves. (13) The video concludes with a close-up of a rabbit eating and a small grey rabbit hopping across a gravel path.

It highlights the emotional appeal of interacting with the large rabbit population while offering practical advice on ferry travel, ticket purchasing, and the necessity of buying rabbit feed beforehand.
